Report: tmp/research-2026-11-16/push/c4-repair-map-engine-r3/REFEREE.md. Every rerun count reproduces (map replay byte-identical; 28 -> 37 closed; 16 -> 29 families; WT/FM edges 0 -> 11; rejected 16,486 / 17,006 / 42,311; top-60 table; scoreboard diff limited to part C) except one statement.

lesson: The ranking noise came from the keyword role 'crossing' (all 60 old top candidates had it), not from missing closed-family patterns: 11 of 13 new patterns match nothing. A device requirement only filters when the role excludes flow/Lambda-side, mean-value, phenomenon and certificate nodes. Also: merge_outcomes.py must be run after every learn step; it had been skipped since batch 1, so closed batch-2 lanes were still treated as proposed. The scoreboard's 'families' count is C(tags,2) and rises with tag vocabulary, not with coverage.
followUp: Replace the keyword role with a curated crossing-device list for existing nodes (54 of the top 60 still depend on the keyword). When c4-fe-stage-rouche-crossing, c4-laxphillips-hecke-compression, c4-helson-discrepancy-zerofree and c4-thin-twist-control-78 report, remove the crossing-device tag or add a closed family for each closed device, and confirm or delete ctl-THIN.
